CTFd for Android

Builds of CTFd for Android, signed by its author and published from https://github.com/bashNinja/ctfd-android on each release.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://bashninja.github.io/ctfd-android/repo
